headline: Forget Realty Income: 4 Other REITs Built for Dividend Investors
summary: Realty Income dominates the conversation, but four other REITs quietly build stronger cases for consistent dividend income across net lease, gaming, industrial, and retail real estate. One of them carries an A- credit rating while paying monthly, and another anchors the group with a yield most blue chips cannot touch.
